description: This Java source file defines the 'DefaultMessageMapperFactory' class, which is responsible for instantiating and managing MessageMapper instances within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity mapping framework. It handles loading payload mappers, extension point integrations via dynamic classloading, and provides methods to create mappers and registries based on specific configurations. The class is integral to the dynamic and configurable message mapping process in the Ditto platform.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating, configuring, and managing instances of MessageMapper for the Eclipse Ditto platform, supporting dynamic class loading, extension points, and configurable mapping behavior.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a DefaultMessageMapperFactory with the specified connection ID, actor system, mapping configuration, and logging adapter.

methods.name: mapperOf
methods.description: Creates and configures a MessageMapper based on a given mapper ID and mapping context.

methods.name: registryOf
methods.description: Creates a MessageMapperRegistry containing default, connection-specific, and fallback mappers based on the payload mapping definition.

methods.name: createMessageMapperInstance
methods.description: Instantiates a MessageMapper based on the specified mapping engine string, applying registered mapper classes and extensions.

methods.name: configureInstance
methods.description: Applies configuration options to a given MessageMapper instance and returns an Optional containing the configured mapper.
